text.en: Pet owners commend the veterinary team, specifically thanking vet Caitriona Ryan and the nursing staff for their calm competence. Clients report that the clinic staff show genuine empathy and patience, making both anxious owners and pets feel supported during visits.

title.en: Caring handling for cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize how gently their pets are treated during routine wellness checks, vaccinations, and unexpected illnesses. Pet parents note that clinicians take deliberate care to put nervous dogs at ease and keep sick cats comfortable throughout clinical treatments.

Clients appreciate the thorough medical explanations provided during appointments, noting that vets explain diagnoses in accessible language. Reviewers highlight practical follow-up guidance and clear discussions that helped families navigate difficult decisions.

q.en: Where is Village Vets Rathfarnham located?

a.en: The practice is situated on Mount Venus Road near the DSPCA animal sanctuary, offering scenic Dublin mountain views and quiet surroundings.

q.en: How do clinicians communicate with pet owners during emergencies?

a.en: Reviewers note that the veterinary team provides clear, compassionate guidance and practical follow-up advice during challenging medical situations.

q.en: Can the staff handle nervous or fearful pets?

a.en: Yes, clients emphasize that vets and nurses work with gentle patience to put frightened dogs and cats completely at ease.
